# Lower bounds only. Exact pins are generated by `scripts/pin.sh` after a
# successful install and written to requirements.lock.
#
# Do not hand-write exact versions here — see docs/COMMAND-RISK-MODEL.md
# "Dependency pinning". scikit-learn and numpy have both shipped breaking
# changes to estimator internals and dtype handling, so the lock file is the
# only trustworthy record of what produced a given model.
#
# joblib's only role in this project is model persistence on the *Python* side
# (ml/artifacts/model.joblib). Nothing about joblib is ever read by the app or
# by the browser runtime — a .joblib file is a pickle and cannot be loaded in
# JS or Kotlin. That is precisely why ml/src/drosh_ml/export.py exists: it
# re-expresses the fitted model as a plain float array the browser can read.

scikit-learn>=1.5,<2
numpy>=1.26
joblib>=1.4

# Test runner for ml/tests/
pytest>=8
